title: [BUY HEAVY!] THIS ONE Stock Runs the Sports Economy
creator: Joseph Hogue, CFA
summary: In '[BUY HEAVY!] THIS ONE Stock Runs the Sports Economy' (published 2 Oct 2026), Joseph Hogue follows up on his earlier Genius Sports video, arguing the market still prices GENI as a narrow sports-betting data vendor while it is becoming the critical infrastructure layer of the $100B+ sports economy. He lays out five pillars: sportsbooks (Genius supplies official real-time data, streaming and trading tech into a $111B global betting market); leagues and teams (NFL, Premier League, NCAA partnerships turn games into monetizable digital products; PWC sees team valuations accelerating); broadcasters and the advertising layer (live game data plus the fan-graph/moments engine won 174 new advertisers in Q2, incl. McDonald's, Airbnb and YouTube TV; the Legend acquisition adds 320M+ annual visits); and prediction markets, where Genius already partners with Kalshi and Polymarket as trusted arbiter (their combined volume rose ~5x in 7 months). These reinforce each other as a flywheel. On valuation he stays near-term conservative: $12/share from 2026E $1.02B revenue at his 5-year average 3.2x P/S, then argues ~$20/share (~270% upside from under $6) if 2027 sales reach ~$1.4B and the stock re-rates to 4x sales (2024 level). He flags the bear case honestly: rising league-rights renewal costs, competition from Sportradar, and that the flywheel must convert into sustained cash flow (guidance: 60% FCF conversion by 2028). Call: GENI BUY.
